frozen: 2026-11-12 (Block 53). Change = new version file; never edit v1 in place.
file: data/<slug>_projections.json (written only by the Projections check after scripts/verify_projections.py passes)
identify_a_fight_by: fighter names (doc.fights[].dog / .fav, matched with scripts/fighter_names.py bout_slots). Never by a fight number: the site event file numbers UFC 334 Gane vs Hokit 14, the card page numbers it 13, and number 3 (Sadykhov vs Nascimento, cancelled) no longer exists.

units.share: fraction 0..1 of THAT fighter's wins (dec + ko + sub = 1 per fighter)
units.pts: difference of two probs, fraction (render x100 with sign)

verified.at.note: added by the check at promote

line_pending.note: bouts held back by the opponent guard: show 'Line pending', no numbers

tag.note: weight tag as the sheet shows it, e.g. 265-5 (5 = five rounds), w = women

sheet.listed.source: Calculator G: dog no-vig at the best bettable prices

sheet.rec.note: absent when Sean does not publish recs: hide, never show '-'

inputs.open_dog.source: Calculator F = sheet open: BFO opener de-vigged, kept from the first card load. Label it 'Sheet open', never just 'Open'.

inputs.markov.source: Calculator J: Markov dog win % as entered, before the card shift

gtd.source: tab Q = true_fav x fav.dec + true_dog x dog.dec (exact)

gtd_listed.source: tab S: best-price raw implied (not de-vigged)

outliers.note: show 'Outlier excluded: <book> <odds>' only when excluded is true

odds_history.type: {source, books, side, through, dog_points: [[time, dk prob|null, fd prob|null]]}
odds_history.note: DraftKings / FanDuel dog no-vig, copied by the check from the site event file; starts at a different time than the sheet open

derived.ITD points per fighter: true_<side> x (ko + sub) = true_<side> - DEC points (exact)
derived.GTD: gtd (the file value is the truth; the two shown DEC points may sum 0.1 off by rounding)

missing: Any optional field absent or null: show an explicit 'not published' / 'not recorded' line. Never a default, never 50/50, never 0%.
checked_by: scripts/render_check.py --embed2 (data-k values, absence lines, sums C1-C6) and scripts/contract_check.py (this file vs a projections file)
